description: This file contains the implementation of a logger class named DefaultDittoLogger which provides logging functionalities via SLF4J, including setting correlation IDs, MDC entries, and various log levels and markers. It appears to be a core utility class specific to the Ditto project, used for structured and correlation-aware logging.

classes.name: DefaultDittoLogger
classes.description: A thread-unsafe implementation of DittoLogger that manages SLF4J logging with support for correlation IDs and MDC entries, allowing chaining of configuration and logging control.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultDittoLogger using an SLF4J Logger.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for the current logger context, accepting either a CharSequence, WithDittoHeaders, or DittoHeaders.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Overrides or sets the correlation ID directly, similar to withCorrelationId but returning the logger for further chaining.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from the current logging context.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds a single MDC entry to the current logger context.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds an MDC entry, allowing method chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries at once, supporting 2 or 3 entries for convenience.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries from MdcEntry objects.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the current logger, cleaning up resources.
